name: Beer Basted Boar Ribs
label: Quest
description: Ragnar Thunderbrew of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos needs fresh crag boar ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt to feed his hungry tavern patrons.…
intro: Ragnar Thunderbrew of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos needs fresh crag boar ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt to feed his hungry tavern patrons. With his regular meat supplier away fighting in the King's Army, Ragnar relies on passing travelers to keep his famed ribs on the menu.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Nothing my tavern patrons enjoy more than some Beer Basted Boar Ribs! Only problem is, the local trapper who used to bring me supplies enlisted in the King's Army to help with the war on the Alliance front.

Maybe you can help me out? If you bring me six crag boar ribs and a Rhapsody Malt from the tavern here, I'll give you the family recipe for my famous Beer Basted Boar Ribs, not to mention a free sample! The secret's in the Malt!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'm going to need six crag boar ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Malt is brewed, the Boars are dead
And before all is done and anything said
We will have to fight for first dibs
On these savory Beer Basted Boar Ribs!
